plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Raymond Burr is credited on 108 distinct recordings across 16 programs from 1949-01-23 through 1958-12-21. Documented roles include performer on 107 recordings, narrator on 1 recordings, and announcer on 1 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Fort Laramie (performer on 40 recordings; 40 distinct recordings), Dragnet (performer on 14 recordings; 14 distinct recordings), Pat Novak, for Hire (performer on 9 recordings and announcer on 1 recording; 9 distinct recordings), Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 9 recordings; 9 distinct recordings), Screen Directors Playhouse (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings), The Line Up (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings), CBS Radio Workshop (performer on 4 recordings and narrator on 1 recording; 5 distinct recordings), and Suspense (performer on 5 recordings; 5 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Captain Lee Quince (40 portrayals) and Inspector Hellman (20 portrayals).
